notes.title: Hey! Small update here!
notes.content:
Ok... so it's been some time... Multiplayer? Uhh... not yet. BUT this update has some changes made before I started working on multiplayer, and I decided to add them today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44111803/ac9572f351f3f209a3bb59f3d265081cff5ebc90.png[/img]

Changelog:
 -Rewrote the entire player system from scratch.
 -Rewrote the entire game manager system from scratch.
 -Rewrote the entire card system from scratch.
 -Added half and full point systems.
 -Added new special abilities and cards with them.
 -Added AI bots to play with (their brains are really small).
 -Added an equipment system.
 -Added new levels in the tutorial.
 -Added draw.
 -Added multiple hooks.
 -Many, many, many, many bugs.
And other things that I don't remember. XD

Bugfix:
 -Fixed character customization preview.
 -Other bug fixes. XD

Ok, I think that's it. I changed these things 2 months ago, so I don't remember too much.
Have a nice day!

notes.title: Quality update and future plans.
notes.content:
Hey! Recently, I had some time so I worked on a few changes in the game. Since the last update, the following have changed:

 -map 30 rework (cars)
 -a few new maps or reworks.
 -stable camera on some maps.
 -new camera shake system (the previous one was too jittery xd)
 -weapons can't shoot through walls anymore (don't ask about the teleportation knife)
 -camera movement rework.
 -added an indicator if the player goes off-screen.
 -improved bullet ricochet system.
 -balance changes in cards mode.
 -new sound system.
 -implosions now stun player.
 -slowmotion gun slow also sounds.
 -shields fix.
 -some bug fixes.

Regarding bugs, sometimes in card mode, input may be lost and you have to press alt + f4. I'm not sure what causes this, but I'll fix it once I understand it.

I'll try to add online multiplayer to the game, but I'm only 17 years old and my knowledge/skills are limited, so I'm not sure if I can do it and how long it will take. If I succeed, I'll consider leaving early access and maybe releasing the game for $2.5 because I've spent a lot of time making this game.

Future plans:

 -Multiplayer via Steam
 -Map editor
 -Achievements
 -TOT solo/coop mode

And please report any bugs to me. I lost my Xbox controller, so I won't be able to fix anything in the coming days...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44111803/91bf35aae2600dc64c843f277b546137d4fea23c.png[/img]

notes.title: NEW CARDS UPDATE!
notes.content:
I recently remembered that I have a game on Steam, so it would be good to add something. I played Rounds recently and thought that "inspiration" from that game wouldn't be a problem.
I didn't have anyone to test my game with, so I assumed there was no need to bother with such mundane things as ‘’testing’’.

New bugs and shortcomings:
- Preview windows in the skin selection look terrible.
- Bullets stop moving after bouncing. I don't know what's going on.
- Cards are a bit too overpowered, so they sometimes crash the game...
- Shields are very messed up and boring – I'll fix them someday.
- Players can leave an arena that should be closed.
- When a player becomes larger, the collider remains the same. (Too big == can't get weapon)
- It's easy to fly off the map when recoiling from a weapon.
- Card description obscures the title of the card.
- Countless other issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44111803/02de785b0e670d5bb367413ab39e25379a6b18b1.png[/img]

Bugfix:
- Now you can randomly select the first map! :))
- I don't remember more, and I apologize for all of them.

New things:
- 2 new weapons.
- Added more than 5 skins.
- New card mode! (beta)
- Button to change whole skin.
- New projectile system.
- Now, 4 players can change skins simultaneously.
- 40 cards with various abilities.
- Now inplosion gun stuns players.
- And many more small changes,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44111803/82a59463cbb95e3779d9122d093f518ca0b50a23.png[/img]

notes.title: UI update, bugfix, etc.
notes.content:
UI and little graphic update.

I added new things: 
-new UI 
-tutorial 
-venom doesn't like other opponents, just as they don't like him.
-curse mode
-weapon statistics now depend on who is wielding them.
-enemy can now disintegrate
-elevators.
-clicking the gameplay modification button again resets the character's statistics.
-some bug fixes.
-many other small changes.

Unfortunately, I don't have anyone to thoroughly test my game with, and I can't check everything on my own, so there "may be"(xd) quite a few bugs.
If anyone wants me to add something, please write it in the review or in the community discussion. I've added a lot of things to the solo/co-op mode, but you won't see them in this update yet.
